tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mgon po'i lus dkyil rdzogs rim bsgom tshul gyi khrid yig kha gsal gzhan phan rgyas byed bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ā nandā puṇyā kīrti dhwa dza shrī bha dra/ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ bla ma dang nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can mchog /brgyud pa dang bcas dges pa rdo rje dang / /bstan bsrung gtso bo gur gyi mgon pa la/ /snying nas thal sbyar gus pas rab 'dud do/ /rje btsun mal gyo'i gdams pa zab mo'i gtso/ /snyan brgyud dam pa snying nang khrag lta bu/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro sbags sgrub 'di/ /gzhan la brtse ba'i bsam pas 'dir brjod bya/ /'dir bla ma mal nas rje btsun sa skya chen po kun dga' snying po la bka' babs pa mal lugs zhes pa zab pa dang rgya che ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs pa'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa snying nang gi khrag dang 'dra ba'i gdams pa khyad par can mgon po'i nang khrid lus dkyil rdzogs rim bsgom tshul dang bcas pa rje btsun brtse ba chen po snying po'i mtshan can nas rim par brgyud de/ mkhyen rab kyi mnga' bdag rtsa ba'i bla ma sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa dang / bka' drin can gyi bla ma mkhas grub chen po sbas pa'i rnal 'byor dpal ldan bkra shis/ yongs 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po dkon mchog lhun grub kyi bar du brgyud pa bar ma chad du byon pa'i gdams pa khyad par can ston par byed pa la/ thog mar slob ma dam tshig shin tu gtsang ba/ khyad par rang la dam tshig gi sel cung zad med pa gcig nas nyer lnga sogs las mang ba mi nyan/ de lta bu'i slob ma rnams bos la nang du slebs pa dang yi ge brgya pa 'don pa spyi dang 'dra ba song nas/ slob dpon gyis gtor chung chus bran pa 'bru gsum gyi byin rlabs byas la/ chos skyong la gtor ma sngags tsam gyis bsngos la phul/ slob ma rnams kyis maṇḍal bdun ma phul tshar ba dang / slob dpon gyis 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/

de'i ched du zab pa las kyang ches zab pa slob dpon bram ze mchog sred kyi bkral bar gyur pa'i rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i nang khrid zab mo gsan la thugs nyams su bzhes snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la rang gzhan 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po las sgrol bar bya ba'i phyir dam pa'i chos nyams su len dgos shing / nyams su len pa la yang lam srol mi 'dra ba bsam gyi mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa las/ lam gyi mthar thug gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam yin la/ nye lam rdo rje theg pa la brten nas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la thob par byed pa la/ phyi rol bdud la sogs pa'i bar chad sna tshogs zhig 'byung ba/ de nyid bzlog pa'i thabs la bsrung ma khyad par can re bsten dgos/ de la yang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa gnyis las/ 'jig rten pa'i bsrung ma ni bsten yang dgos pa chung ste/ gnas skabs tshe 'di nyid du phan phran tshegs re re tsam thogs kyang / gnas skabs su 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las skyobs cing / mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i grogs dan byed mi nus te/ rgyal sras sems dpa' chen pos/ rang nyid 'khor ba'i brtson rar bcings pa yi/ /'jig rten lha yi su zhig skyob par nus/ /zhes gsungs pas chos rnams kyi snying rje'i mgron gyis gtor ma re tsam ster ba ma gtogs bsten cing sgrub par bya ba ma yin/ des na 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bsrung ma'i dbang po khyad par can re bsten dgos/ de'ang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i rgyud sde rnams las bsrung ma'i rnam grangs bsam gyi mi khyab pa zhig gsungs kyang / kun gyi gtso bor gyur pa ni nag po chen po 'di nyid yin te/ rgyu mtshan yang / bsrung ma gzhan rnams ni phyogs re ba'i sprul pa yin la/

rdo rje nag po chen po 'di nyid ni bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed pa'i sprul pa yin te/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po'i dkyil 'khor bsdus pa'i rtog pa le'u bco lnga pa las/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs las rdo rje nag po chen po 'di nyid phyung ste/ hūm̐ gi yi ge las skyes pa/ /lag pa gnyis pa mgo gcig pa/ /kha dog nag po drag po che/ /'bar ba'i gri gug thod pa 'dzin/ /zhes sogs kyi bstan pa ltar bsrung ma mchog 'di'i rnam par gzhag pa cung zad brjod na/ rgyud las ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul/ gsungs pa'i dgos pa/ mtshan gyi don/ rgya gar du bka' srol ji ltar byung ba/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i phyag tu babs pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po rgyud las gsung tshul ni/ rdo rje gur gyi le'u bco lnga pa las/ nag po chen po 'di nyid kyi mngon par rtogs pa dang / gtor ma'i rgyu/ bzlas bya'i sngags ring thung / liṅga la brten pa'i las sbyor rnams gsungs shing / dpal ldan lha mo 'di ni gdan bzhi'i rgyud rgyas pa dang / lhag ma'i skabs su gsal bar gsungs so/ /mgon po mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ mgon po phyag gnyis pa nas phyag 'bum pa'i bar gyi sgrub thabs gsungs pa las/ phyag gnyis pa 'di nyid rgyas par bstan/ dur khrod nag po'i rgyud las lha lnga ma dang / bcu gnyis ma dang / bcu bdun ma rnams kyi dbang bskur dang sgrub thabs rgya cher bshad/ 'on kyang bcu bdun ma bstan pas gyi ljang dbu dkar ba'i lugs dang mthun pas thun mong ba yin no/ /lha mo la mkha' 'gro ma me lce 'bar ba dang / ma mo srog gi 'khor lo'i rgyud sogs 'dug ste rnam par dag pa yin min dpyad dgos par zad do zhes zhal snga nas blo gros rgyan mtshan dpal bzang pos man ngag gi dkar chag tu gsungs so/ /gnyis pa gsungs pa'i dgos pa ni/

sems can gyi bde skyid sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rag las pas de nyid yun ring du gnas par bya ba dang / man ngag tshul bzhin nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi lam gyi bar chad sel zhing lam mthar phyin pa'i dgos pa de ltar du gsungs pa yin no/ /gsum pa mtshan don ni/ gur gyi mgon po zhes grags pa yang ston pas rgyud gsung pa'i dus rdo rje gur gyi bsrung mar bka' bsgo mdzad pas gur mgon zhes dang / rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi mgon grogs mdzad pas na mgon po zhes grags so/ /bzhi pa bka' srol ji ltar byung na/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug birwa pa nas legs par brgyud pa lam 'bras lugs kyi mgon po/ rdo rje gdan pa las brgyud pa sgrub thabs kun las btus kyi lugs/ paṇa chen shākya shrī las brgyud pa'i lugs/ bram ze mchog sred nas rim pas brgyud pa mal lugs te/ bzhi ka rjes gnang dang sgrub thabs zung 'brel du bzhugs pa yin la/ gzhan slob dpon bsod snyoms pas mdzad pa sogs mang du yod kyang / sgrub thabs rkyang pa las mi snang bas zhib tu ma smos so/ /lnga pa rje btsun sa skya pa rnams kyi phyag tu ji ltar babs tshul ni/ rje ga ya dha ra dang 'brog mi las rim par brgyud de/ bla ma zhang dgon pa la rje sa chen gyi gsan pa lam 'bras lugs 'di la sgrub thabs chung ngu gcig bzhugs so/ /gnyis pa kun las btus pa'i lugs ni/ ba ri lo tsā ba la sa chen gyi gsan te brgyud lugs kyi rjes gnang dang / sgrub thabs kyi gzhung bram ze chen pos mdzad pa yod de/ lugs gsum pa ni kha che paṇa chen gyis/ chos rje sa skya paṇa chen la gnang ba la gsang bsgrub spu gri skor gsum gyi man ngag rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ bzhi pa lo chen rin bzang las brgyud pa/ bla ma mal las rje sa chen gyis gsan pa 'di la man ngag shin tu rgya che bas brjod par mi nus mod/ 'on kyang cha tsam brjod na/

mgon lha bcu gnyis ma/ lha brgyad/ lha lnga rnams kyi dbang bskur ba dang / lcam dral/ lha brgyad/ bcu gnyis ma/ 'khor rkyang rnams kyi rjes gnang / phyi nang gsang ba'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa shin tu rgyas par bzhugs shing / bsgrub tshul gyi rnam par bzhag pa rab tu mang po bzhugs na yang / don gyi snying por dril na rkyang par bsgrub pa dang / sbags te bsgrub pa gnyis/ dang po pho rkyang du sgrub pa/ mo rkyang du bsgrub pa/ 'khor rkyang du bsgrub pa'o/ /pho rkyang du bsgrub pa la/ bka' bstod ltar bsgrub pa/ gnod sbyin ltar bsgrub pa/ tshogs bdag ltar bsgrub pa/ gshin rje ltar bsgrub pa'o/ /mo rkyang du bsgrub pa ltar rtsub lugs su bsgrub pa/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa ltar 'jam lugs su bsgrub pa'o/ /'khor rkyang du bsgrub pa la/ thun mong ba sde brgyad kyi tshogs bsgrub pa/ thun mong ma yin pa phyi'i las mkhan gcer bu zangs gri can/ nang gi las mkhan ber nag zangs gri can/ gsang ba'i las mkhan pu tra lcam sring / bran bdud gshin rje nag po la sogs pa'o/ /sbags te bsgrub pa la/ lcam dral sbags te bsgrub pa/ mkha' 'gro sbags sgrub 'di la/ lha brgyad mkha' 'gro sbags sgrub dang / bla ma yi dam lha brgyad phyogs gcig tu bsgrub pa gnyis las/ da lan thun mong ma yin pa bla ma yi dam sogs phyogs gcig tu bsgrub pa'i lugs yin/ de la mkha' 'gro 'khu ldog spong ba'i man ngag la/ phyi lha tshogs kyi man ngag drug ni/ gnyen po lha'i gnad/ gnyen po sngags kyi gnad/ ngan sngags kyi dug mda' khongs su 'phangs pa/ rdzas kyi rdo rje dam la bzhag pa/ las mgon mya ngan las 'da' ba/ drag sngags go bzlog gi gnad do/ /nang sngags tshogs kyi man ngag drug ni/ chos skyong rang la log na/ dgra la rdugs na/ bar du steng na/ 'khyams na/ las ma btub na/ sbod kha 'doms na de dag spongs ba'i thabs so/ /gsang ba thun mong ma yin pa mkha' 'gro'i 'khu ldog spong ba'i man ngag lnga ni/

dgra bo'i yul khams brlag par byed pa'i man ngag dgra bo rims nad kyi 'debs par byed pa spu gri so 'debs kyi man ngag chos skyong gi srog snying dbang du bya ba'i gnad/ gsang ba yang thig blang ba'i man ngag ma mgon gyi srog dbang du bya ba rdzas gsang ba mal 'og gi gnad/ mgon po gzi brjid bskyed cing btsan po'i mkhar du 'jug pa thod pa kha sbyor gyi man ngag rnams so/ /de ltar man ngag bcu bdun po 'di rnams gseb tshags su bcug nas nyams su len pa las dkyus gcig tu bsgril nas nyams su len rgyu med/ des na dang po rang nas mkha' 'gro'i 'khu ldog mi 'byung bar byed pa gsang ba thun mong ma yin pa'i mkha' 'gro'i 'khu ldog spong ba ma mgon gyi srog snying dbang du bya ba rdzas gsang ba mal 'og gi gnad kyi bca' thabs ni bsgrub pa gang du bya ba'i sa yul der/ dong gru gsum khru gang pa gcig brus pa'am bzos pa der khyi'am spre'u gang 'byor gyi ya thod mche ba ma nyams pa gad legs par byas pa'i ltag khung nas yungs kar blug pa'i nang du/ pu tra'i bla rdo pha waṃ long bu'am/ rdo cho long zhes pa rang grub tu yong ba de 'dra gcig gi ya ldeb la yaṃ/ ma ldeb la maṃ bri/ shog bu ring ba bla rdo dang zheng tshad mnyam pa gcig la ming sring gsum gyi bod pa gnyis/ de nas rbad pa gnyis/ de nas bsad pa gnyis rnams sbrel nas bri/ de yang yum sngon la yong ba mos pho bskul ba yin/ yig gzhug nas g.yon bskor du bla rdo'i ya ldeb ma ldeb bzhag pa'i zur bzhi nas gril ba'i yig mgo rnams ya'i phyogs la yong bar byas nas/ gos bzang kha la gril yaṃ steng dang / maṃ 'og sa'i phyogs la bstan la ya thod kyi yungs kar gseb tu bcug der yungs kar gyis bar mtshams med par bskang / pra tshil lam 'ber gyi ldag khung sogs srub yod pa thams cad bkag rlung mi 'chor bar bya/ rlung shor na sel du 'gro gsung /

ya thod re ba nag pos bstums la sngar gyi dong gru gsum zur gcig lhor bstan pa der bcug la/ 'tshul pa yang lhor bstan/ chos 'byung gi nang rnams sol phyes bskang / 'byor na ro g.yam/ ma 'byor na g.yam pa gru gsum gang 'byor la ro sol gyi rdo rje rgya gram bris pas kha bcad/ de'i steng zhal ba gzhan dang khod snyom par byas/ der mal bca'o/ /mal dang 'tshams pa'i ji ltar rigs par rten mgon po'i thang sku dbus/ kye rdor g.yas/ bde mchog g.yon/ stegs gang 'os su dam rdzas gtor ma gcig nas bdun gyi bar gang 'byor bskang gso byed na de'i gtor ma rang rang gi mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len bzhin dang / mchod pa thun mong ba chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga bshams pa ste bca' gzhi rnams legs par grub nas/ khrid kyi rim pa rnams nyams su len pa la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po sngon 'gro ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ 'gal rkyen sgrib pa sbyong ba rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas/ mthun rkyen tshogs gsog pa maṇḍal gyi rnal 'byor/ byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi 'khu ldog spong ba'i phyir mchod gtor phul nas gsol ba gdab pa dang lnga yod pa las/ do nub nyams su len par byed pa la/ dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi sngon du rang rang gi gnas khang du/ bla ma yi dam gyi rten dang mchod pa ci 'byor pa bshams pa'i mdun du rang nyid srab mo'i stan la 'dug nas/ thog mar skyabs 'gro'i yul gsal 'debs dgos pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi bskor ba'i dbus su gzhal yas khang pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du gur gyi mgon po lha brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa/ de'i steng gi cha la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ shar du yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs/

lhor sangs rgyas dkon mchog nub tu chos dkon mchog gi ngo bo po ti brag ri brtsegs pa lta bu/ byang du dge 'dun dkon mchog mtha' bskor du mkha' 'gro chos bsrung gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs kyis bskor ba rnams gsal btab la/ skyabs 'gro drug skor ma bya ste/ ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus da nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la༞ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams༞ dam pa'i chos rnams༞ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams༞ mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsrung ma'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes pa gang nus brjod nas/ skyabs yul rnams mi bsdu bar maṇḍal 'bul ba'i yul du bzhag de nas sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum gyi sems bskyed pa ste dang po'o/ /gnyis pa rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gong du song bas/ rang gi spyi bor padma dang zla ba'i steng du skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' dpal he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gi brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gi bzhugs pa/ rang 'dra'i rigs bdag gi dbu rgyan can/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/

phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po las 'od 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas hūm̐ las bdud rtsi babs/ he ru ka'i sku gang / dbyibs brgyud/ yum gyi sku gang / yab yum gyi sku thams cad las bdud rtsi babs/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu'i rnag khrag gi rnam pas bshang gci gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis nas 'thon nas shul thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badzra he ru ka twe no pa tiṣṭha ḍi ddho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ sarba siddhimme pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shrī yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wan badzra he ru ka ma me muñtsa badzra he ru ko bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa brgya rtsa la sogs pa bya/ de nas/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig la ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes pa dang ltung ba dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yab yum 'od du zhu nas spyi bo nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus shel sgong g.ya' dag pa lta bur gyur zhes brjod pa ste rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas so/ /gsum pa maṇḍal dbul ba ni/

rang gi mdun du nas gtsang ma sa rdo sbu gsum med pa ji ltar rigs pa dang / li la sogs pa'i maṇḍal dri bzang gi chu sogs bshams la/ maṇḍal tshom bu bdun ma dbul zhing / nyi shu rtsa re tsam song ba dang 'gal rkyen zhi zhing mthun rkyen 'grub pa'i gsol ba blo la re ba med pa gdabs/ thun bsdud ran pa dang / skyabs yul rang la thim zhes brjod cing bde ba dpag tu med pa skyes par bsams la cung zad cig mnyam par bzhag de nas dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam btab/ de ltar thun bzhir bcad nas nyams su len pa yang / srod dang tho rangs skyabs 'gro dang / rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas byed/ nyin gung dang dgong mo maṇḍal 'bul ba yin pas lus sems rtse gcig tu bsgrims nas byas pas sdig pa dag pa'i rtags ma byung bar du bya dgos so/ /de rnams la do nub kyi thugs dam mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yi sogs brjod la slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang ngo // //sang nyin skabs bab la slob ma rnams yig brgya 'don pa sogs 'dra/ de nas slob dpon gyis gtor chung phul/ slob ma rnams kyi maṇḍal bdun ma phul tshar ba dang / slob dpon gyi sems bskyed gsal btab nas/ bka' bab tshul sogs gong bzhin ji ltar rigs pa song rjes sngon 'gro sogs gsum gyi sngon 'gro la don tshan lnga yod pa'i dang po gsum mdang dgong gyi gnas skabs su song zin/ do nub kyi gnas skabs su/ bzhi pa byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su len pa la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ rang gi spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i nag po chen po de'i spyi bor 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog lhun grub/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor dpal ldan bkra shis pa rnams dbyer med pa'i sku can/ de'i spyi bor spyan tshab pa tshul khrims bzang po dang / 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen dbyer med pa'i sku can/

de'i spyi bor bla ma dpal ldan rgyal po/ de'i spyi bor 'jam dbyangs blo gros rgyal mtshan/ de'i spyi bor 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ de'i spyi bor mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mchog de'i spyi bor yar klungs pa seṅge rgyal mtshan/ de'i spyi bor dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ de'i spyi bor rin po che seṅge bzang po/ de'i spyi bor mkhas pa yon tan khri/ de'i spyi bor rgyal tsha lung mang po/ de'i spyi bor 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa/ de'i spyi bor bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇḍi ta/ de'i spyi bor rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ de'i spyi bor slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ de'i spyi bor rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ de'i spyi bor bla ma mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags/ de'i spyi bor brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ de'i spyi bor lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po/ de'i spyi bor shārdha ka ra warma/ de'i spyi bor nor bu gling pa bde ba'i rdo rje/ de'i spyi bor bram ze mchog sred/ de'i spyi bor sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang rnams mtho brtsegs su bzhugs pa la gus 'dud drag po dung pa zhig byas pas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma de rnams so so'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs nas bla ma so so la thim pas bla ma rnams sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor mos la/ rdo rje 'chang la skyabs su mchi/ sogs rigs 'gre thams cad la 'dra ste/ nag po chen po'i bar skyabs 'gro gsol 'debs/ 'od du zhu ba/ rim pa bzhin bstim pa dang mthar nag po chen po 'od du zhu/ rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin skyes par bsam la de'i ngang la cung zad cig mnyam par bzhag lnga pa mkha' 'gro'i 'khu ldog spong ba/ chos skyong la mchod gtor 'bul ba/

mchod gtor dgos pa rang rang gi phyag len bzhin bshams la/ dpon slob rnams gral la 'khod de/ gnas yo byin rlabs mdzad nas kye rdor gyi bdag bskyed bsgom/ gtor bsngo/ bskang ba rnams rang rang gi phyag len dang mthun pa grub mtshams/ tshogs kyi yo byad slob mas yod na dang / med na bla mas ji ltar rigs pa mdzad/ cho ga kye rdor ram/ phur pa gang rigs bya'o/ /de nas gtor 'bul rjes chog sogs spyi dang mthun/ thun gtor 'og nas 'bul/ de rnams kyi sngon 'gro'i chos rnams song nas/ dngos gzhi sang nyin ji ltar rigs pa la yong bas de ring thugs dam de la mdzad pa zhu/ bsod nams 'di yi sogs 'dra'o// //dngos gzhi la slob ma rnams mdun du 'byor pa yig brgya/ gtor chung 'bul ba/ maṇḍal 'bul ba rnams song nas/ slob dpon gyi sems bskyed gsal btab la/ rdo rje nag po chen po 'di nyid la chos kyi bka' babs bzhi ni/ sa skya pa chen po la lugs gsum dang / bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇḍi ta la bka' bab par gyur pa dang / sku'i bka' babs ni bla ma mal gyi bse 'bag nag po 'phur shes sa chen la sku'i rjes gnang gi dus gnang / gsung gi rjes gnang dus dar nag la shā na bris pa gnang / thugs kyi rjes gnang dus lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa gnang / yon tan gyi rjes gnang skabs man ngag gi be'u bum bse'i ga'u 'od 'bar sogs gnang / bla ma ba ri lo tsā bas rdo mgon rje sa chen la gnang / pu hrang lo tsā bas shing mgon sa skya pa chen po la gnang / bris mgon 'phags pa rin po che'i phyag tu bab ste sku'i bka' babs bzhi'o/ /de ltar gur gyi mgon po bsgrub par byed pa la dngos dang / de'i yan lag mkha' 'gro 'khu ldog spong ba'i man ngag gnyis/ dang po la spyir rkyang bsgrub dang / sbags bsgrub las 'dir sbags bsgrub/ de la yang lcam dral sbags bsgrub dang / mkha' 'gro sbags bsgrub las 'dir mkha' 'gro sbags bsgrub/

de la'ang lha brgyad sbags bsgrub thun mong du grags pa dang / bla ma yi dam lha brgyad phyogs gcig tu bsgrub pa/ thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las 'di phyi ma/ gnyis pa mkha' 'gro'i 'khu ldog spong ba'i man ngag la/ phyi lha tshogs la brten pa'i man ngag drug la sogs pa gong du bstan pa bcu bdun por 'dus pa las thog ma rang nas rdzas gsang ba mal 'og gi gnad dgos pas gong du bstan pa ltar nyams su blangs te mal sogs bca'o/ /sbags bsgrub thun mong ma yin pa 'di la 'jam por bsgrub pa/ cung zad rtsub tu btang nas bsgrub pa/ shin tu rtsub tu btang nas bsgrub pa dang gsum yod pa las/ dang po 'jam por bsgrub pa la rten dang mchod gtor bshams pa gong bzhin dang / thun mong ma yin pa khrag gi arghaṃ dbang po lnga'i me tog tshil chen gyi bdug spos/ zhun chen gyi snang gsal/ 'khris pa'i dri chab/ sha rus kyi zhal zas rnams mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len bzhin bshams nas/ bsgrub pa la bsnyen bsgrub las gsum las bsnyen pa ni/ do nub rang gi gnas khang du srab mo'i gdan la 'dug ste gnas yo byin rlabs byas la bdag bskyed skyabs 'gro nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa bzhin nam/ lam dus byed bzhin pa yin na lam dus dang sbrel nas nyams su blang / dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i tshe bsrung 'khor mi bsdu bar bzhag de nas gtor ma du yod gong du sbyangs tshar na dang / ma tshar na 'dir nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs la gtor ma du yod byin gyis rlabs nas/ bzlas gtor rnams phul nas bris sku la mgon po lha brgyad kyi dam tshig pa bskyed grub tshar mtshams/ rang kye rdo rjer gsal ba'i lte ba'i rtsa 'khor gyi dbus su rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i mdud pa yongs su gyur pa las e ka dza ti sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dar dkar gyi na bzas stod g.yogs pa/

stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ ral pa'i lan bu gcig tu gyur nas g.yon du 'phyang ba/ khro mo'i rnam pa can/ rus pa'i rgyan dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhes 'dir e ka dza ti bskyed tshad la 'dra/ de zhu ba las 'od kyi gong bu cha gsum du gyur pa'i cha gcig dbu ma dang ro gcig 'dres pa las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga/ de yongs su gyur pas dpal kye rdo rje sku mdog sngon po nas/ gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje bdag med ma zhes pa nas me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin bskyed/ cha gcig g.yas ro ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las gri gug sngo nag de las 'od 'phros dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po sku mdog mthing nag che zhing cher 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ phyag gnyis kyi dbus na rnam 'phrul gser gyi gaṇḍe bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dmar la bzlum pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dbu sku dang / smin ma sma ra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thams can/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod paṇa dang lhab lhub kyis klubs pa/ mi'u thung gel ba'i 'dug steng na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas na bya nag g.yon na khyi nag rgyab na ce spyang / mdun na mi nag steng na nam mkha' lding gi sprul pa'i pho nya 'phro ba/ mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /cha gcig g.yon rkyang ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las tri shu la rtse gsum sngo nag de las dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma bong bu gwa pa la zhon pa/

sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ gnyis pa na thod pa khrag gi gang ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi dang po na mdung / gnyis pa na rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing / ba glang gi ko bas smad g.yogs pa/ re lde'i sham thabs can/ klu'i dbang po'i ske rags bcings pa/ mi ro rengs pa khar bcug nas mche ba gtsigs pa/ snyan g.yas pa la dug sbrul g.yon pa la seng ges brgyan pa/ sku la khrag gi thig le/ zhal gi zo ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod pa/ shin tu rid pa lte ba'i thad ka nas nyi zla 'char ba/ ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sde'i dbus na hūm̐ dang bhyo'i sgra sgrogs pa/ mgon po'i thugs ka nas nag po gnod sbyin dang pu tra bha ṭa'i ngo bo yi ge yaṃ tri tri/ lha mo'i thugs ka nas nag mo gnod sbyin dang gser gyi spu gri ma'i ngo bo maṃ dang bhyoḥrnams spros te gong ma gong ma las 'og ma 'og ma cung zad dma' bar gnas pa/ phyi nang gi lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ kye rdo rje dang mgon pa'i thugs ka'i stod du nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ sngon po re re/ lha mo'i thugs ka'i stod du nyi ma la gnas pa'i bhyoḥsngon po/ thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i kye rdo rje mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ mgon po kun gshegs gdan la bzhengs/ /lha mo kun gshegs gdan la bzhengs/ /las mgon kun gshegs gdan la bzhengs/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ /gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang / /shākya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /bdag cag rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ e hye hi/ he badzra shrī ma hā kā la ya/ mahā kā li de wī sa pa ri wa ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ padma ka ma lā ya satwaṃ/ oṃ arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ a lo kaṃ gandhaṃ/ nai bi dyaṃ/ shapta pra tītstsha swāhā/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba'i mthe bong gnyis nang du bcug pa mgon po'i dam rgya bcas te/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya/ sor mo phan tshun cung zad bsnol ba'i rdo rje thal mo kha sbyar ba las mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i rgyab tu bzhag pa lha mo'i dam rgya bcas la/ ma hā ka li de wī ye/ mgon po'i dam rgya bzhin bcas la/ badzra kā la yakṣa ye/ badzra kā li yakṣi ṇi/ badzra yakṣa pu tra ye/ badzra ru tra bha ṭa ye/ badzra ru lu rakṣa si sa pa ri wa ra/ sa ma ya sma ra si/ sa ma ya mā ti kra ma tha/ sa ma ya rakṣantu/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' stod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar dam tshig bsrung / bstan pa skyongs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ khyad par du yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang / rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gnod cing 'tshe ba dang / bdag gi lam bsgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams kyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad zhi ba'i thabs kyi 'dul bar mdzad du gsol/ gal te zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul du ma 'tshal na/ thal mo brdab cing / gang la gang 'tshams pa'i chad pas bcad pa dang / bskrad cing gzir ba dang / dbye ba dang / bsdigs shing dpa' bskong bar mdzad du gsol/ mdor na chos bsgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub cing / bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa dang / 'jig rten pa kun dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod cing dam la bzhag rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/

oṃ shrī mahā kā lā ya/ mahā kā li de wī sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyoḥbi shwa mu khe bhyeḥ sarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhne daṃ ba lyā di swāhā/ lan gsum/ sha sa na/ lha mo'i ro ru sogs lan gsum re phul/ oṃ shrī mahā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā li de wī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyi mchod/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes mgon po dang / oṃ ro ru ro ru sogs kyi mjug tu gong ltar 'bru gsum brjod pas nang mchod phul te/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang / 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang / bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing / mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'phrin las bcol/ de nas gdong bzhi pa/ dur khrod bdag po/ las mgon/ dkar bdud/ phur bsrung / mkha' 'gro spyi gtor/ gzhi bdag gtor ma sogs sngar nas gtor ma gang 'bul so so'i phyag len bzhin gtor chog ltar gang dgos 'bul ba/ phyir bskyed pa'i bsrung ma rnams la phul tshar ba dang / nang du bskyed pa dang / phyi'i bsrung ma rnams la nang gi gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ rang kyai rdor gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyi nang gi dgra bgegs gdug pa can rnams tshar bcad sha khrag gi phung po chen por gyur/ de'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung / raṃ las me/ a las thod pa'i nang du sha khrag gi phung po de nyid sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yongs su gyur pa las gtor ma zag pa med pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyi byin gyis rlabs la/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/ oṃ he badzra shrī mahā kā lā/ mahā kā li de wī sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te sogs lan gsum/

gong bzhin phyi nang gi mchod/ bstod pa dang bstab pa rgyas bsdus skabs su gang bab bya/ nang gi gtor ma 'di ras bris la bskyed pa'i lha brgyad sogs chos bsrung rnams la yang 'bul bar bsam/ de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros lha brgyad 'khor bcas la phog pas rang gi gang bsgom pa'i 'phrin las bzhi'i las rnams bsgrub par bsam la/ de wa pi tsu ji ltar rigs pa bzlas/ lcam dral la bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las ngo bo sngags la rnam pa gri gug gi rnam pa can mang po byung / shangs bug g.yas nas thon/ lcam dral gnyis kyi shangs bug g.yon nas zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang bhyo'i zhabs kyu ya ta rnams mar me gcig las gnyis 'chad kyi tshul du bcad nas byung / shangs bug g.yas nas 'thon/ bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yon nas zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim par mos pa yi ge bcu gnyis ma/ bdun ma gang mos dang / lha mo'i ro ru sogs bzlas/ las mkhan rnams la bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ las mkhan rnams la phog pas rang gi gang bsgos pa'i 'phrin las bzhi'i las rnams bsgrub par bsam la bod pa gnyis bzla/ mthar bcom ldan 'das nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ bdag gi chos bsgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang / phyi nang gi dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i nus pa dang ldan par byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ zhes brjod nas 'di'i mtshams su bshags pa dang / spro na bsrung ma rnams la so so'i phyag len bzhin bskang gso dang bstod pa byed/ bsdu na bstod pa tsam byas kyang chog de nas rdo rje'i glu bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa rigs su skye dang sogs kyi bsngo ba smon lam byas la yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyi nongs pa bzod par gsol/ ras bris sogs gtor mgron gyi rten yod rnams la brtan bzhugs/

med pa rnams la gshegs gsol sogs spyi dang 'dra la/ khyad par ni yaṃ dang tri tri gnyis mgon po la thim/ maṃ dang bhyoḥganyis lha mo la thim/ lcam dral gnyis bcom ldan 'das la thim/ bcom ldan 'das 'od du zhu nas thig le sngo skya 'dril ba bzlum pa brjid pa 'tsher ba sran ma tsam gcig tu gyur/ de nas lte 'og sor bzhi'i gnas su chos 'byung smug nag zur gsum zur gcig mdun du bstan pa'i nang du/ dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma sku mdog smug nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi sogs gong ltar bskyed/ sngar gyi thig le de lha mo'i spyi bo nas zhugs/ dbu ma'i lam nas byon/ lha mo'i bha ga'i nang du bla ma yi dam chos skyong kun 'dus kyi ngo bo hūm̐ sngon po gcig tu gyur/ zhes brjod pa ni gsang rten la phyi nang gsang gsum yod pa'i gsang ba'i gsang rten 'chang ba/ yi dam lcam dral gsum la phyi nang gsang gsum yod pa'i dang po ni zhal phyag gi rnam pa can/ gnyis pa ni ro kun 'dar ma gsum/ gsum pa ni gsal ba mgon po/ stong pa lha mo/ dbyer med yi dam/ 'dir lte ba lus chags pa'i thog ma yin pas gzhan la ston pa'i tshe lte ba nas ston la/ de nyid las gzhan du bsgom du mi rung ba ma yin te/ de'ang 'jam par 'dod na 'khor lo lte ba dang / gsang gnas su phab la bsgom/ rtsub par 'dod na snying ga dang mgrin pa dang spyi bo sogs su bteg la bsgom/ gtor ma yang 'jam par 'dod na lhag ma la bslab ces pa 'bag tu 'jug pa yin/ rtsub par 'dod na phud la bslab ces gtor ma ma 'bags pa gtsang sbra che bar byed dgos/ de dag gis ni bsnyen bsgrub las gsum las bsnyen pa bstan zin pas do nub kyi thugs dam de la mdzad pa zhu/ bsod nams 'di yi sogs bya'o// //sang nyin slob ma mdun du slebs nas yig brgya maṇḍal gtor 'bul sogs 'dra/ de nas slob dpon gyi sems bskyed gsal btab/

gong bzhin man ngag gi bshad pa ji ltar rigs pa byas la/ bsgrub pa ni cung zad rtsub tu gtong ba yin te/ mgon po dang nang gi las mgon ber nag zangs gri can dang brje dgos te/ 'di'i rjes gnang ma thob na ma brjes kyang chog pas de ltar shes par byas la bris sku la mgon po lha brgyad kyi dam tshig pa bskyed pa nas rtsa ro rkyang gsum lhar bskyed pa'i bar gong bzhin la/ mgon po'i thugs ka nas yaṃ dang tri tri las nag po gnod sbyin sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas lcags kyi gri gug g.yon par ba gdengs pa'i mthil du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ dar nag gi na bza' dang mi lpags kyi g.yangs gzhi gyon pa/ tri las las kyi mgon po pu tra nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas pa lcags kyi ral gri dang / g.yon thod pa khrag gi gang ba 'dzin pa/ dar gyi aṅga rag dang / dar nag gi na bzas brgyan pa/ tri las bha ṭa nag po stag slog can g.yas gsher shing gi dam shing dang / g.yon mi'i snying 'dzin pa/ lha mo'i thugs ka nas maṃ dang bhyoḥspros pa las maṃ las nag po gnod sbyin g.yas gser gyi spu gri dang / g.yon par ba gdengs pa'i mthil na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ byi ru'i lan tshar can/ bhyoḥlas sring mo khrag mig ma kha nas me 'bar ba phyag g.yas spu gri/ g.yon mi'i rgyu ma 'dzin zhing za 'og na tri'i gos gyon pa lnga ka'ang sku mdog mthing nag rab tu khros pa rus pa'i rgyan dang / mi mgo skam pos dbu rgyan dang / dgra bgegs kyi rgyu ma la rgyus pa'i rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa'i do shal can/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ sogs nas dam bzhag bar dang / nang gi gtor ma 'bul ba/ bstod pa/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa sogs nas rdor glu yan gong bzhin bya/ 'on kyang shā sa na la mjug gi mā ra ya bcad pa dang / las mgon rnams la bod rbad gnyis sbrel la bzla ba'o/ /de nas bshags pa skang gso bstod pa byed/

bsdu na bstod pa tsam byas la rdor glu sogs gong bzhin bya/ ma 'byor ba sogs kyis bzod gsol brtan bzhugs byas nas gnod sbyin yab dang pu tra bha ṭa rnams mgon po la thim/ gnod sbyin yum dang sring mo gnyis lha mo la thim/ lcam dral gnyis bcom ldan 'das la thim sogs gsang rten gyi bar rdzogs par bsgom pa ste de rnams kyi do nub kyi thugs dam mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yi sogs brjod la slob ma rnams btang // ༈ /sang slob ma rnams kyi maṇḍal 'bul ba yig brgya gtor 'bul sogs 'dra/ bla mas sems bskyed gsal 'debs pa sogs byas la/ las sbyor la nang gi rnal 'byor gyi spro bsdus spyir las la sbyar ba dang / phyi nang gi rnal 'byor gyi khyad par gyi las la sbyar ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ yi dam gyis mgon po bskul/ mgon pos lha mo bskul/ lha mo'i thugs ka nas gnod sbyin yab yum gnyis spros/ gnod sbyin yab yum gyi thugs ka nas ming sring gsum spros nas 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad par bsam nas shā sa na tshang ma dang bod rbad gnyis sbrel la bzla/ gnyis pa nang gi rnal 'byor gyi las la sbyar ba ni/ liṅga bcas nas de la dgug gzhug bya ste/ slob dpon gyi rdo rje dril bu dang bcas pas hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ dzaḥn mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi༞ chos kyi༞ dge 'dun gyis༞ bcom ldan 'das kye rdo rje la sogs pa'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyis lha tshogs rnams kyi༞ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' bstod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa/ yum chen sring mo bzhi sogs rdo rje'i chos skyong ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi༞ chos nyid rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag cing / chos can las 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang /

bden pa chen pos byin gyis rlabs kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa'i gang zag rnams dang / khyad par du rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gnod cing 'tshe ba/ bsam pa ngan pa/ sbyor ba rtsub pa/ do brdo ba'i dgra bgegs gang yin pa/ ming dang rus su smos pa/ gzugs dang liṅgar bcas pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad skad cig nyid la gzugs dang liṅga 'di nyid la mchis par gyur cig oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ oṃ ro ru ro ru bi tiṣṭha ba to si ka ma la rakkha si/ mo'i rbad pa ni/ trag raksha kha munt+ra ru lu ru lu/ trag raksha snying khrag snying bhyoḥ pu tra pu tra bhyoḥ sha sha trag sha sha trag tra mo tra pa/ sha trun mā ra ya/ pho'i rbad pa ni/ dhṛka dhṛka ya du pa sha ni sod/ duṃ shig ā gad dzaḥ a gad dzaḥ ya dn-ir y-i dnar mon bu dzaḥ mon bu khrag la 'jib dzaḥ sarba sha trun bighnan ā karṣa ya ā karṣa ya/ mā ra ya hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ces pa lan gsum/ lha dbye ni gong bzhin dgug gzhug gi 'jug log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad skyob par byed pa'i lha dang khrol cig 'go bar byed pa'i lha dang khrol cig bsrung par byed pa'i lha dang khrol cig pho lha/ dgra lha/ zhang lha/ srog lha/ yul lha la sogs pa'i bsrung skyobs byed pa'i lha dang khrol cig bsrung 'khor dang yi dam chos skyongs sogs kyi nus mthu dang khrol cig oṃ shrī mahā kā lā ya'i rjes su ro ru dang rbad pa gnyis gong bzhin gyi mthar sarba sha trun bighnan sarba de wa rakṣa bi de sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ mkhyen par gsol ba ni/ hūm̐ bla ma dkon mchog dgongs su gsol/ /sangs rgyas dkon mchog dgongs su gsol/ /dam chos dkon mchog dgongs su gsol/ /dge 'dun dkon mchog dgos su gsol/ /chos skyong bsrung ma dgongs su gsol/ /steng gi lha dang bar gyi gnyan/ /'og gi klu dang phyogs skyong bcu/

/'byung po mthu chen dgos su gsol/ /phyogs bcu'i dgra bgegs sdig pa can/ /bla dang gzugs su bzung ba 'di/ /ming dang rus su smos pa 'di/ /'dzab dang liṅgar bris pa 'di/ /bsgral ba'i yul du byas pa 'di/ /bskal pa dpag med sngon rol nas/ /sangs rgyas dbu 'phangs smod pa dang / /dam chos dkon mchog bstan pa bsnub/ /dge 'dun bstan pa 'di yi bshig /sems can yongs la gnod 'tshe byas/ /'tshams med lnga dang nye ba lnga/ /mi dge bcu yi las rnams spyad/ /mchod 'os drin can khyad du bsad/ /bstan 'dzin bla ma'i sku la brdos/ /de 'dra'i dgra bgegs sdig can 'di/ /des na bsgral ba'i dus la bab/ /des na bsgral ba'i gnang ba zhu/ /des na bsgral ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces brjod/ de nas las sbyor rang la yang 'jam por bsgrub pa/ cung zad rtsub tu btang nas bsgrub pa/ shin tu rtsub tu btang nas bsgrub pa gsum po la/ rang bsgrub pa po la nang du rtsa dang 'khor lo la lha bsgom pa la sogs pa rnams liṅga la'ang bsgom nas/ 'jam por bsgrub pa ni rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mgon po 'khor bcas la phog de'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros gnod sbyin yab yum la phog de'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ pu tra mi sring gsum la phog pas de rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas de rnams las sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul dpag tu med pa dang 'od zer 'phros nas bsgrub bya liṅga'i lus nang gi lha rnams la phog pas de rnams khros te g.yas kyi phyag mtshan rnams klad la kor bas bsgrub bya'i lus nang gi rtsa la sogs pa rnams rbad rbad bcad nas thum hril hril tshar bcad par bsam/ sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul rnams kyi bsgrub bya'i lus kyi phyi nas mtshon chas dum bur btub par bsam nas sha sa na dang bod rbad bsad gsum sbrel la bzlas/

yang sngags ma 'das par dmigs pa bsgom pa gcig pos kyang chog pas nan tan bskyed nas bsgom pa gal che bas de ltar bsam nas bya ba rnams la do nub kyi thugs dam de la mdzad pa zhu/ bsod nams 'di yi sogs brjod/ las sbyor sogs kyi bar la gzhan gyi rigs sngags dang rbod stong bzlog dgos byung na/ sa skya pa chen po sogs kyis mdzad pa'i rdo rje'i brag rdzong bsgom pa'am/ yang na nged kyis byas pa'i rdo rje brag rdzong ma bsgom pas 'thus zhing / de'i zhal bzhes tshigs bcad ma bzhin/ phal cher 'thus yod/ bsrung 'khor bsgom pa yang thun mtshams gang bder bsgom pas chog 'di'i dus sam gzhan du'ang rmi lam gyi ltas byung na/ gtor bsngos kyi bzlas pa'i skabs su dmigs pa rnams bsgom/ bdag bskyed dang ma 'brel na/ rang skad cig gis mgon por bsam nas bzlas pa rnams byas pas chog bsrung 'khor gyi zhal shes tshigs bcad ma bzhin gyi/ bsrung bya sba ba la rang gi snying khar pad nyi'i steng du gri gug de'i lte bar nyi ma'i steng du rang gi sems kyi ngo bo hūm̐ mthing nag de'i klad kor gyi nang du bla ma rnal 'byor rgyud nas bshad pa'i mi bskyod pa'i rnam pa can/ de'i pad gdan gyi 'og tu mtshan gyi yi ge dang po ste sku dang gsung gnyis/ hūm̐ gi phyi mtha' na phar pha ma la sogs dngos su bsam/ hūm̐ de'i zhabs kyu'i nang du rang gi ming yig dang po/ de'i g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab rnams su pha ma sogs kyi ming yig dang po spu shad kyi bris pa tsam bsgom ste lus ngag gnyis/ de nas nag po chen po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros nas bla ma dang bsrung bya rnams kyi rnam par shes pa rang rang gi ming yig dang po'i rnam par bkug nas hūm̐ gi nang gi mtshan dang ming yig rnams la bstim pas sku gsung thugs dang lus ngag yid gsum tshang / de nas nag po chen po'i thugs ka nas rdo rje nag po nas 'bras tsam dpag tu med pa 'phros nas bsrung bya'i sku gsung thugs dang lus ngag yid gsum thams cad la rdo rje'i go bkon/

byad ma bsad pa'i zhal shes tshigs bcad ma bzhin brjod na/ rang la gnod 'tshe che shos rang byed pa'i dgra ste/ mi'i 'gro ba'am/ bgegs te mi ma yin pa'i 'gro ba pa lces brang kheb pa/ nu ma gnyis kyi bar gyi lus nang du rnam shes kyi rten khrag gi thig le mthe bong tsam gcig bsam/ 'og tu tri las kho las bsrung skyobs byed mkhan gyi lha bsrung gang yin de bsgyel/ de'i steng du tri las gzugs med kyi bgegs dang / de'i steng du nṛ las gzugs can gyi dgra rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa rnams lus kyi rnam pa gan rkyal du byas snying khar lag pa bsnol ba ste lus dang / de'i steng lces brang kheb pa ngag dang / snying kha'i nang du khrag gi thig le'i dbus su hūm̐ bsam pa yid ste lus ngag yid gsum tshang / de gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i lce steng na mar 'khor lo'i mar rtse zug pa/ rtsibs bar gyi rlung me'i steng du dgra bgegs gzhan rnams bsam nas/ dgra yin na nṛ dang / bgegs yin na tri las gnod byed lus rid pa/ skra 'dzings pa/ kha nas khrag kyugs pa/ lus thams cad la shu ba'i phreng bas bskor ba/ spyi bo tshugs su gnas par bsam/ 'og gi de la rang la mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'gro ba yin yang rung ste/ lus kyi sgo nas rdzas ngan bsags pa dang / phur gdab byed pa sogs bkug nas 'og gi byad ma'i lus la bstim/ ngag gi sgo nas sngags zla ba dang dmod pa 'dor ba sogs ji snyed yod pa bkug nas byad ma'i ngo bo lce la bstim/ sems kyi dmigs pa ji snyed byed pa thams cad bkug nas byad ma'i sems kyi ngo bo hūm̐ la bstim/ yang nag po chen po'i thugs ka nas khro bo lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros nas dgra bgegs kyi lus ngag yid gsum kar bkug nas rtsibs bar gyi gnod byed kyi gzugs can la bstim/ yang nag po chen po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/

khro bo bcu dang phyi rigs 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad la phog pas de thams cad kyi srog snying phul/ dper na gdugs kyi rtsib ma rnams mgo bo'i shing gi 'khor der 'dus pa ltar srog snying rnams 'od zer gyi rnam par mgon po'i thugs kar thim pas thams cad kyang zhal phyir gzigs/ steng 'og gi khro bo rnams zhabs g.yas brkyang du bsgyur nas sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul dpag tu med pa 'phros de dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad sha la zo/ khrag la 'thung / yang las dbang gi skad cig gi lus grub pa de rnams bkug ste rtsib bar gyi gzugs can la bstim nas gzugs can rnams rtsibs kyis btub/ mes bsregs pa dang / rlung gi gtor ba dang / 'khor lo g.yon du 'khor bar dmigs nas shā sa na ji ltar rigs pa bzlas la rjes su shā sa na'i i daṃ duṣṭaṃ ces pa'i mjug tu byad ma kha kha/ byad ma khā hi khā hi/ byad ma ma ra ma ra/ byad ma gṛhna gṛhna/ byad ma bandha bandha/ byad ma ha na ha na/ byad ma da ha da ha/ byad ma pa tsa pa tsa/ byad ma 'di na me ke na ma ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa nyer gcig la sogs pa bzlas la/ thal mo sbyar nas/ su gang dag bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang sogs bsrung 'khor gyi nang bzhin brjod pa'o/ /bzlas pa'i skabs su yi ge bcu gnyis ma dang bdun ma gnyis ji ltar rigs pa bzlas pa'i rjes su/ shā sa na spel tshig can gtso bor bzlas pa'o/ /de'i dus su mi'i 'gro ba pas kho'i bsrung ma rnams rbad nas byung na/ nag po chen po'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung / zhal nas thon/ mdun gyi nag po chen po'i zhal nas zhugs/ lte ba nas thon/ rang nag po chen por gsal ba'i lte ba nas zhugs pa'i 'khor sngags la gri gug dpag tu med pa 'phros nas 'og gri gug gi sa gzhi/ khor yug gri gug rwa ba/ steng gri gug gi gur phyi rol thams cad dgra bgegs ma lus pa bsreg par nus pa'i ye shes kyi me 'bar bar bsam la shā sa na dang bod rbad bsad gsum bzla/

yang mi ma yin pa'i dgra bgegs kyi gnod pa yod na 'khor sngags de las dug dang me dang mtshon dang nad sna tshogs 'phros nas dgra bgegs de tshar bcad par bsam la shā sa na sogs gong bzhin bzla/ yang pha rol pa'i 'gro ba po yin nas khos kyang nag po chen por 'khor bcas rbad kyi rtsar byung bas/ bsgrub pa po'i nag po chen po 'khor bcas rnams/ bkrag mdangs dang gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pas ma bzod nas log song ste kho rang gi bsgrub pa po dngos la tshig pa zos nas tshar bcad par bsam/ 'di'i nag po chen po 'khor bcas rnams kyang 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor nas dgra bgegs gang yin pa'i sar song nas de tshar bcad par bsam la sngags shā sa na dang bod rbad bsad gsum bzla/ 'di'i dus su mkha' 'gro'i 'khu ldog byung na dgra bo'i yul khams rlag par byed pa'i man ngag dang / dgra bo rims nad kyi 'debs par byed pa spu gri so 'debs kyi man ngag gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rang mgon por gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sngags kyi phreng ba byung zhal nas 'thon/ mdun gyi mgon po'i zhal nas zhugs/ lte ba nas 'thon/ rang gi lte ba nas zhugs pa'i 'khor sngags dang / gnyis pa ni mdun bskyed kyi mgon po'i bshang lam nas 'thon/ rang gi bshang lam du zhugs pa ma gtogs 'dra/ de 'dra'i 'khor sngags las nad dang dug dang me dang mtshon sna tshogs dang nad kyi rnam pa 'od zer dmar smug pa lhag pa chen po gtsang rlung lta bu yor yor song nas thog ma la dgra bo'i yul khams tshun chad rlag par bsam pa shā sa na sogs bzla/ gnyis pa la dgra bgegs gang yin pa de'i lus la zhag bdun du 'chi bar nges pa'i nad kyi phog pas mar la 'khru ba dang / yar kha skyugs pa la sogs pa dang / dug gis brgyal ba dang / mes bsregs/ mtshon gyis btub pa la sogs pa'i dmigs pa byas la shā sa na sogs bzla/ 'di'i skabs su rmi lam ngan pa dang /

ltas ngan pa byung na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi/ shū n+ya tā brjod nas thun mong ba'i bsrung 'khor bsgom la/ de'i dbus su padma nyi ma dgra bgegs gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag de las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid nag po chen po cher 'bar ba sogs gtor chog bzhin bskyed/ de'i lto ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su gshin rje dmar nag 'jigs su rung ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon sdigs mdzub 'thur du bstan pa/ zhal gdengs pas dgra bgegs log 'dren la rngams pa/ de'i lto ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su 'og tu nyi ma g.yas su 'khor ba steng du zla ba g.yon du 'khor ba gsal btab nas shā sa na nyer gcig bzla/ de nas mgon po gshin rje nyi zla rnams gsal ci thebs thebs gcig byas nas rang mgon por gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer sna tshogs lcags kyu lta bu gcig phyogs bcur 'phros nas rmi lam ngan pa dang ltas ngan pa gang byung ba de 'od dang mdangs thams cad nyams pa'i rnam pa cig rang gi mdun du bkug oṃ shrī ma hā kā ya shā sa na zhes pa nas i daṃ duṣṭan gyi bar brjod/ de nas mgon po'i shangs kyi rtse mo nas 'od zer sngon po lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ sngags kyi nyi zla gzas bzung ba lta bu'i rnam pa de zhal gyi 'khris su bkug de zhal du 'jug pa'i steng ka lan gsum byas/ steng rlung mnan te chom za ba'i rnam pa byas nas kha kha khā hi sogs sngags lhag ma yid kyi bzlas zin pa dang / dkan gcig rtog te mid pa'i steng ka byas nas 'og rlung bskum ste mnan nas kha sbyar bzung / sems kyis gshin rje'i zhal du chom zos/ phye mar song ba de mid pas lto ba'i nyi mas bsregs/ zla bas bzhu/ ro ma san sen byung ba de bshang lam na yar song ba'i dmigs pa byas nas rlung btang /

de lta bu'i rlung sbyor nyer gcig song nas smon lam btab pa ste khro bcu'i bsrung 'khor bsgom pa nas 'di'i bar gyi man ngag rnams thun mtshams gang 'os su rmi lam sogs mtshan ltas nam byung gi dus nyams su len pa yin no// //de nas slob ma rnams sleb pa dang dgra bgegs la/ gtor chung 'bul ba/ maṇḍal sogs gong bzhin byas nas/ slob dpon gyis sems bskyed gsal btab la/ gnyis pa de las cung zad drag tu btang nas bsgrub pa la bdag bskyed mgon po rang gi mdzad pas mgon po khro bcu'i bsrung 'khor bsgom ste/ rang mgon por gsal ba'i lto ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su padma nyi ma bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ mthing nag de las 'od 'phros sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das snying po kye rdo rje sku mdog sngon pos gnyis ka'ang ye shes me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i bar gsal btab/ de'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlabs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i kyai rdo rje nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badzra nī rī te sogs chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga dang / dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis mchod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim pa'i rkyen gyis skad cig gis rang gi lus kyi rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi gsang gnas na/ rang bzhin gyis gnas pa'i chos 'byung rnams bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i kye rdo rje mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i rang bzhin du gyur pa ni spyi bo nas gsang gnas kyi bar du rtsa dbu ma/ g.yas su ro ma/ g.yon du rkyang ma/ rtsa gsum la brten pa'i snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo/ mgrin par longs spyod kyi 'khor lo/

spyi bor bde chen gyi 'khor lo/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo/ gsang gnas na rang bzhin gyi gnas su chos 'byung smug nag zur gsum/ zur gcig mdun du bstan pa ni rten gyi dkyil 'khor yin la/ snying kha'i chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus dbu ma'i nang gi hūm̐ nyid e ka dza ti zhes nas khro mo'i rnam pa can gyi bar gong bzhin bskyed/ de'i lto ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang gi dbus su nag po chen po dang / de'i g.yon du 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma sogs gong bzhin bskyed/ mgon po'i thugs ka nas yaṃ dang tri tri/ lha mo'i thugs ka nas maṃ dang bhyoḥspros te lcam dral gnyis kyi mdun na phar gnod sbyin yab yum sogs lngar gyur pa ni yaṃ las nag po gnod sbyin/ maṃ las nag mo gnod sbyin/ tri las pu tra/ tri las bha ṭa/ bhyoḥlas sring mo rnams gong bzhin bskyed/ e ka dza ti'i steng dbu ma'i nang du bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i kye rdo rje sku mdog nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin bskyed/ 'di rnams la gdan mi byed pa ni dma' phab nas nga rgyal bcog pa ste mi gnyan du gtang ba'i gnad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ gi mtha' bskor du rtsa sngags snying po nye snying / yum gyi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du phreng sngags dang snying po/ mgon po 'khor bcas kyi thugs kar yang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ bhyoḥtraṃ yaṃ maṃ tri tri bhyoḥrnams kyi mtha' skor du mgon po'i rtsa sngags shā sa na sogs snying po nye snying / lha mo'i thugs kar bhyoḥ'i mtha' skor du oṃ ro ru sogs kyis bskor/ e ka dza ti'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ e ka dza ti sogs kyi bskor/ gnod sbyin yab kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du yaṃ gyi mthar oṃ badzra kā la yakṣa ye dang bod rbad bsad gsum sbrel bas bskor/

gnod sbyin yum gyi thugs kar maṃ gyi mthar oṃ badzra kā li yakṣi ṇi ces pa'i mthar bod rbad bsad gsum sbrel bas bskor/ pu tra'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du tri'i mthar/ oṃ badzra kā la pu tra ye'i rjes su bod rbad bsad gsum sbrel bas bskor/ bha ṭa'i thugs kar nyi mi'i steng du tri'i mthar oṃ badzra ru dra bha ṭa ye'i rjes su bod rbad bsad gsum sbrel bas bskor/ sring mo'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du bhyoḥ'i mthar oṃ badzra ru lu rakkha si'i rjes su bod rbad bsad gsum sbrel bas bskor/ sngags ring thung rnams kha dog nag po mgo gyen la bstan pa g.yas bskor du 'khor bar gyur/ zhes brjod/ lha de rnams kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlabs nas ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa/ mchod pa gnyis kyi mchod pa bstims pa rnams gong bzhin/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ khro bo bcu/ lha mo drug dang bcas pa oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ gong bzhin mchod pa gnyis kyis mchod/ zhe sdang rdo rje sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /nas/ khyed kyi bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ /sogs dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /sogs kyi mjug tu oṃ badzra bhā wa a bhi ṣ-iñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bor nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las phyi nang gi he ru ka gnyis la mi bskyod pa/ gzhan thams cad kyi spyi bor rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa re res rgyas btab par gyur/ zhes brjod/ dmigs pa la bskur byed nam mkha'i lha de rnams kyis rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa re re phyag tu bsnams te mgon po 'khor bcas kyi spyi bor bzhag nas dam pa btags pa'i mos pa byed de/

rdzas kyi rdo rjes dam la btags pa'i man ngag kyang byin no/ /de nas dam bzhag gtor 'bul mchod bstod sogs rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar nas byed/ de nas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i kye rdo rje'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mgon po 'khor bcas la phog pas mgon po 'khor bcas cung zad skrag nas 'dar phril phril byas nas rang gi gang bsgo ba'i phrin las rnams bsgrub par bsam la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi rtsa sngags snying po nye snying rnams brgya rtsa tsam/ yum gyi phreng sngags dang snying po de tsam zhig bzlas pas gnya' mnan nas/ de nas mgon po'i rtsa sngags dang shā sa na la ming sring gsum gyi bod rbad bsad gsum gyi bar la tal tal sbrel ba tshar gsum brjod pa ni gnyen po sngags kyi gnad do/ /de nas yi dam gyi de ba pi tsu brgya rtsa tsam bzlas pas gnya' mnan nas bsnyen pa gang la byed pa'i sngags de la gcig gril du byed/ sngags gzhan rnams mjug tu kha tshang tsam re bzla/ de yang lcam dral gyi snying po/ e ka dza ti'i sngags ni/ oṃ e ka dza ti de ba ind+ra si bhyoḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ ces dang / las mkhan rnams la bod pa gnyis gtso bor bzlas so/ /grangs ni mgon po dang lha mo gnyis la bzhi 'bum sogs bzla/ las mkhan rnams la mtshan ma nam byung gi bar du bzla'i grangs mi byed gsungs/ de nas 'dod don gsol gdab gong bzhin byas nas bcom ldan 'das kyis thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa la phog pas de rnams kyi thugs ka nas sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul dpag tu med pa 'phros/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ 'od zer sngon po'i rang bzhin nam mkha' lta bur byas/ yang 'od zer de rnams tshur la 'dus nas mgon po 'khor bcas la thim pas mgon po 'khor bcas bkrag mdangs gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par bsam pa lan bdun tsam byas nas mthar bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/

phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma ri rab kyi rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa/ snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas phyi rigs 'jig rten skyong ba rnams la thim/ de rnams 'od du zhu nas khro bo bcu gcig la thim/ de rnams 'od du zhu nas nang gi lha brgyad la thim/ gnod sbyin yab pu tra bha ṭa rnams mgon po la thim/ gnod sbyin yum sring mo lha mo la thim/ lha mo mgon po la thim/ bcom ldan 'das e ka dza ti mgon po la thim/ mgon po 'od du zhu nas thig le sngo skya 'gril ba bzlum pa brjid pa 'tsher ba sran ma tsam du gyur/ zhes brjod nas de la sems bzung / rlung kha sbyar bzung ba lan bdun tsam bya/ de nas thig le de gnyis cha gnyis su gyur pa'i bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i kye rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ yum rdo rje bdag med ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur pa snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo'i steng dbu ma'i nang na bzhugs pa/ cha gcig gsang gnas na rang bzhin gyis gnas pa'i chos 'byung smug nag zur gsum pa zur gcig mdun du bstan pa'i nang du dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma bong bu gwa pa la zhon pa sku mdog smug nag ces pa nas hūm̐ dang bhyoḥ'i sgra sgrogs pa'i bar gong bzhin bskyed/ de'i spyi bo nas zhugs/ dbu ma'i lam nas byon/ lha mo'i bha ga'i nang du bla ma yi dam chos skyong kun 'dus kyi ngo bo hūm̐ mthing nag gcig tu gyur pa' ིhūm̐ gi klad kor nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu'i bar du 'od kyi srad bu dmar po rta rnga tsam gcig gi zung sbrel nas rten 'di la brtan par bzhugs te/ ji srid bla med byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bdag gi mgon skyabs dang / dpung gnyen dam pa dang / dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad du gsol/ zhes brjod/……thig le sngon po la sems bzung ba 'di la thun gcig dang /

thig le dmar po/ dkar po/ ser po/ ljang khu 'di rnams la thun gcig gtang / mthar mgon po 'od du zhu nas thig le dmar po/ dkar po/ ser po/ ljang khu 'dril ba bzlum pa ces pa nas spyi bor yin na dkar po/ mgrin pa yin na dmar po/ snying ga yin na dmar po/ snying ga yin na sngon po/ lte ba yin na ser po/ gsang gnas yin na ljang khu ces rigs 'dre shes par bya'o/ /thig le la sems bzung / rlung kha sbyar bzung ba gong thig le sngon po'i skabs ltar bya/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i kye rdo rje'i mgrin pa dang / spyi bor bskyed pa yin na mar byon nas snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i stod du bzhugs ces dang / lte ba dang gsang gnas yin na yar byon nas snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i stod bzhugs ces so/ /de ltar bsgom pa la brten nas gnas khang yid du mi 'ong ba/ yid du 'ong ba dang / sngar thal ba chags yod na phyis snum du song ba dang / khang stengs su 'od dmar po chags pa dang / bsgom mi 'dod pa bsgom snying 'dod pa dang / du ba la sogs pa'i rtags lnga dang / rtags kyi rtags lnga la sogs pa byung nas sa lam rnams rim gyis bsgrod de rdo rje 'chang chen po thob par 'gyur ro/ /de dag la nan tan gyi sgo nas bsgom pa de la do nub kyi thugs dam mdzad pa zhu/ bsod nams 'di yi sogs brjod// //sang nyin slob ma rnams mdun nas slebs nas yig brgya/ maṇḍal gtor 'bul sogs 'dra/ de nas slob dpon gyi sems bskyed de gsal btab/ gsum pa shin tu nas kyang drag tu btang nas bsgrub pa la cho ga'i mgo mjug rnams gong du bstan pa bzhin las khyad par med cing cung zad mi 'dra ba'i dmigs bsal yod pa rnams gzhung bzhin byed/ khro bcu'i bsrung 'khor rdo rje'i brag rdzong ma sngon du song nas nag po chen po'i lto ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du padma nyi ma dgra bgegs gdug pa can rnams gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag de las 'od zer 'phros gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/

tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje nag po chen po gong bzhin bskyed/ de'i sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlabs/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i kye rdo rje mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lngas mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim pa'i rkyen gyis skad cig gi rang gi lus kyi rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi/ gsang gnas na rang bzhin gyi gnas pa'i chos 'byung rnams bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i kye rdo rje mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i rang bzhin du gyur pa ni/ spyi bo nas gsang gnas kyi bar du dbus su rtsa dbu ma/ g.yas su ro ma/ g.yon du brkyang ma de rnams kyi yas sna sna bug gnyis su zug pa/ rtsa gsum la brten pa'i snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo/ gsang gnas na rang bzhin gyi gnas pa'i chos 'byung smug nag zur gsum/ zur gcig mdun du bstan pa ste rten gyi dkyil 'khor yin la/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus rtsa dbu ma'i nang gi aṃ nyid e ka dza tir bskyed/ de'i steng dbu ma'i nang du padma dang nyi ma dgra bgegs gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i steng du rdo rje nag po chen po bskyed/ de'i steng dbu ma'i nang du padma nyi ma bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan la bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i kye rdo rje nas gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i bar brjod/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 'og g.yon brkyang ma'i nang du padma dang nyi ma'i steng khrag gi rgya mtsho'i dbus su dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma bskyed/ de'i 'og tu padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la nag mo'i gnod sbyin sku mdog nag mo/ g.yas gser gyi spu gri nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/

g.yon par ba gdengs pa'i mthil na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ de'i 'og tu padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la gser gyi spu gri ma sku mdog nag mo gser gyi spu gri nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon rgyu ma dang bcas pa'i par ba gdengs pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 'og g.yas ro ma'i nang du padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la nag po gnod sbyin sku mdog nag po g.yas lcags kyi gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon par ba gdengs pa'i zangs kyi sen mo lcags kyu lta bus dgra bo la 'debs par byed pa/ de'i 'og tu padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la pu tra nag po g.yas gsher shing gi dbyug tho nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pa par ba gdengs pa'i mthil du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin zhing zangs kyi sen mo lcags kyu lta bus dgra bo la 'debs par byed pa/ de'i 'og tu padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la bha ṭa thal skya g.yas lcags kyi spu gri nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon par ba gdengs pa'i zangs kyi sen mo lcags kyu lta bus dgra bo la 'debs par byed pa/ zhes dam tshig pa bskyed/ gnyen po lha'i gnad ni/ mgon po'i spyi bor bcom ldan 'das/ gzhan thams cad kyi spyi bor nag po chen po/ g.yas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ 'khor 'jig rten dregs pas bskor ba re res rgyas btab par gyur/ gnyen po'i sngags ni bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag de'i mtha' mar rtsa sngags/ snying po/ nye snying / gzhan rnams kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ traṃ bhyoḥ maṃ bhyoḥ yaṃ tri tri rnams kyi mtha' skor du shā sa na yi ge bcu gnyis ma/ yi ge bdun ma/ gzhan rnams la rang rang gi sngags ring thung rnams sngags kha dog nag po mgo gyen du bstan pa g.yas bskor du gnas par bsam pa gong bzhin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi rtsa sngags/ snying po/ nye snying / yum gyi phreng sngags snying po rnams brgya rtsa bzla/

de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi sngags bzung nas bod rbad bsad gsum sngags thung yan tshar re tal tal sbrel nas bzlas pa lan gsum bya/ de nas rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ khro bo bcu/ lha mo drug dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ mchod pa gnyis kyis mchod pa/ zhe sdang rdo rje sogs kyi bstod gong bzhin/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /sogs dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni sogs kyi mjug tu/ oṃ badzri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ bum pa'i chu'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las thams cad kyi spyi bor rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa re res rgyas btab par gyur/ slar yang bskur byed nam mkha' lha rnams kyi/ rdo rje 'di ni rdo rje che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi byin gyis rlabs/ /gal te dam las 'das gyur na/ /zhig 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /ma hā sa ma ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pas dam la bzhag slar yang rdo rje blang pa'i mos pa byed/ de nas phyi nang gi gtor bsngo sngar bzhin byas la bzlas pa'i gong du rlung kha sbyor bdun la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pa byed/ de nas srin lag g.yas pa'i rtsa bar mthe bong bzhag mthe bong gi rgyab tu srin dang mthe'u chung gnyis bkug pas mnan/ gung mdzub brkyang pa'i rgyab tu mdzub mo bzhag pas sna bug g.yas bkag nas rlung ro lan gsum 'bud/ de nas 'og rlung cung zad bskum pas lte ba'i aṃ bskul/ de las me cung zad 'bar bas e ka dza ti bskul/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas mgon po bskul/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas yi dam bskul/ yi dam las 'od zer 'phros pas dregs pa mo rgyud kyi lha tshogs rnams la phog pas sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul dpag med 'phros pas spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar gang / nang gi dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/

dregs pa mo rgyud kyi lha tshogs su byas/ bcad bya gcod byed kyi dregs pa mo rgyud kyi lha tshogs rnams rlung phar 'gro ba dang bstun nas sna bug g.yon nas song / 'jig rten khams kyi dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ dregs pa mo rgyud kyi lha tshogs su byas/ de nas tshar bcad bya gcod byed rang bzhin gyi gnas nas byon pa'i dregs pa mo rgyud kyi lha tshogs rnams tshur 'dus sna bug g.yon nas zhugs nas nang gi dregs pa mo rgyud rnams la thim pa lan nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam byas pas dbang du 'dus par bsam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma thams cad 'od du zhu ste 'od zer gyi rnam par byon nas dregs pa mo rgyud kyi lha tshogs rnams la thim pas bdag gi rgyud byin gyi rlabs par bsam/ de bzhin du pho rgyud/ gnyis med rgyud gnyis la'ang 'gre/ de nas bzlas pa ni gong du bstan pa dang khyad par med pas de bzhin bya'o/ /bzlas pa tshar ba'i rjes su go bzlog gnad ni/ sngags rnams mgo mjug ldog pa bzhin gyi thog mar mo'i bsad pa dang / de nas rbad pa/ de nas bod pa bzla/ de bzhin du pho'i bsad pa/ rbad pa/ bod pa rnams bzla/ de nas lha mo'i ro ru dang / e ka dza ti'i sngags/ mgon po'i yi ge bdun ma/ bcu gnyis ma/ shā sa na rnams re re bzhin lan gsum tsam bzla/ mang na mkha' 'gro'i nus pa nyams 'gro bas mi legs gsungs/ las sbyor byed na skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa bsdu ba'i bar dang / gtor ma 'das gtor nas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi bar bsngos nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros nang gi lha brgyad dang phyi'i lha brgyad la phog de nas sprul pa dpag tu med pa 'phros nas 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad par bsam nas/ shā sa na dang bod rbad bsad gsum yan ci rigs bzla/

de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros phyi'i lha brgyad la phog pas de dag las sprul pa dpag tu med pa spros/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas nang gi lha brgyad la phog de dag las sprul pa dpag tu med pa spros nas 'jig rten gyi khams kyis dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ sha la zos/ khrag la 'thung / yang las kyi dbang gi lus de grub/ yang tshar gcod par bsam nas/ dmigs pa la mi gnod na shā sa na bzla/ gnod na ma bzlas kyang chog de nas gong du sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum du byas pa'i dang po gnyis song /……'di yan la thun gcig gnang ngo / rjes la gnyis/ bdag bskyed kyi rjes dang / mdun bskyed kyi rjes so/ /dang po ni/ las mkhan mya ngan las 'da' ba'i man ngag gi gnad de/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros nang gi lha brgyad dang phyi'i lha brgyad la phog pas de dag las sprul pa dpag tu med pa spros/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad ming sring gsum du byas/ yang bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ de rnams la phog pas gnod sbyin yab yum gnyis su byas/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas de rnams lcam dral gnyis su byas/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas de rnams e ka dza tir byas/ yang 'od 'phros pas de rnams kye rdo rjer byas/ de rnams phyi rigs 'jig rten skyong ba rnams la thim/ de rnams khro bo bcu gcig la thim/ de rnams nang gi lha rnams la thim/ nang gi dregs pa mo rgyud rnams gnyis med rgyud la thim/ pho rgyud kyi lha rnams kyang gnyis med rgyud kyi lha rnams la thim/ e ka dza ti mgon po la thim/ kye rdo rje yang mgon po la thim/ mgon po 'od du zhu nas thig le ser po 'dril ba/ zlum pa/ brjid pa/ 'tsher ba bsran ma tsam gcig tu gyur pa lte bar gnas zhes brjod/ de la sems bzung rlung kha sbyar bzung /

de nas thig le de cha gnyis su gyur pa'i cha gcig bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i kye rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ yum rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i skur gyur pa/ yar byon nas snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i steng dbu ma'i nang na bzhugs/ cha gcig gsang gnas na rang bzhin gyis gnas pa'i chos 'byung smug nag zur gsum/ zur gcig mdun du bstan pa'i nang du dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma bong bu ga pa la zhon pa sku mdog smug nag ces pa nas ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sde'i dbus na hūm̐ dang bhyoḥ'i sgra sgrogs par bskyed/ de'i spyi bo na mar zhugs/ dbu ma'i lam nas byon/ bha ga'i nang du bla ma yi dam chos skyong kun 'dus kyi ngo bo hūm̐ sngon po gcig tu gyur pa'i klad kor nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu'i bar 'od kyi srad bu dmar po rta rnga tsam gcig gi zung sbrel nas rten 'di la brtan par bzhugs te/ ji srid bla med byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bdag gi mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad du gsol/ de nas gsang gnas/ snying ga mgrin pa/ spyi bo rnams su spos la rim pa bzhin bsgom ste/ de rang mgon po zhu ba'i thig le gsang gnas su ljang gu/ snying gar sngon po/ mgrin par dmar po/ spyi bor thig le dkar po 'dril ba zlum pa brjid pa sran ma tsam gcig tu gyur/ zhes brjod cing rigs 'gre shes par bya'o/ /gsang gnas yin na yar byon/ snying ga dang mgrin pa spyi bo yin na mar byon/ zhes pa khyad par tsam mo/ /gnyis pa mdun bskyed kyi rjes ni mgon po gzi brjid bskyed cing btsan po'i mkhar du 'jug pa thod pa kha sbyar gyi man ngag ni mdun bskyed mchod pa dang bcas pa'i 'og tu/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo a āḥsogs tshar gnyis brjod nas zhu ba las byung ba'i thod pa dkar po srub med pa yangs shing rgya che ba/

mdun bskyed mchod pa dang bcas pa'i steng du dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i ngo bo ka kha sogs tshar gnyis brjod nas/ zhu ba las byung ba'i thod pa dkar po srub med pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ steng gi thod pa'i nang gi dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ mthing nag mgo 'thur du 'phyang ba/ de'i 'og tu oṃ āḥhūm̐ rim pa bzhin mgo gyen la bstan pa/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i mthar g.yon bskor du ā li kā li dang ye dharmā mgo thur du bstan pas bskor bar bsam la ā li kā li dang ye dhar sbrel ba tshar gcig brjod/ g.yas bskor du ā li kā li dang ye dhar mgo 'thur du bstan pas bskor bar bsam la ā li sogs tshar gcig brjod/ de nas rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs kar hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa la phog pas/ de dag las rdo rje nas 'bras tsam dpag tu med pa 'phros nas mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i lus la rdo rje'i go bkon par gyur/ zhes brjod nas mgon po'i rtsa sngags snying po nye snying / lha mo'i ro ru e ka dza ti/ las mkhan gyi bod rbad bsad gsum rnams nyer gcig re/ badzra kā la yakṣa sogs sngags 'thung lnga po lan bdun re bzla/ thod pa kha sbyar la dkyus su ā li kā li ye dhar rnams sbrel bas bsdams par bsam la/ ā li sogs tshar gcig brjod/ de bzhin du 'phred du bsdams par bsam la ā li sogs tshar gcig brjod/ de nas 'jug tu ye dhar lan gsum brjod nas/ ā li kā li'i srad bu nag pos rgya gram du bsdams te mi mthun pa'i phyogs gang gis kyang mi ched pa'i nus pa can du gyur/ zhes brjod/ mgon po'i gzi brjid bskyed pa'i man ngag thod pa kha sprod/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa bskyed pa btsan po'i mkhar du 'jug pa'i man ngag go /de dag gi sgrub thabs dngos rdzogs so/……'di yan la thun gcig gnang ngo /

/mkha' 'gro'i 'khu ldog spong ba phyi lha tshogs kyi man ngag drug ni/ gnyen po lha'i gnad/ gnyen po sngags kyi gnad/ ngan sngags kyi dug mda' khong du 'phang ba/ rdzas kyi rdo rjes dam la bzhag pa/ las mgon mya ngan las 'da' ba/ drag po sngags go ldog gi gnad rnams so/ /nang sngags tshogs kyi man ngag drug ni/ dang po rang la log na ye shes kyi mgon po gshegs su gsol bar/ oṃ mahā kā la kro dha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa yi ge bcu pa la mgon po'i bcu gnyis ma btags la bzla'o/ /gnyis pa dgra la sdugs na bod rbad bsad gsum gyi sngags 'chol bar bzlas so/ /gsum pa steng na/ rang gos nag po gyon/ skra thor tshugs su bcings/ btsun pa la sogs pa skra med pa rnams skra tshab lta bu brdzus ma'i skra la bya/ gdong la khrag dron mo byugs nas dgra bo'i yul la kha bstan/ chang phud gtor zhing las sbyor gyi sngags dang dgra'i ming spel ma bzlas/ bskul tshig rnams drag tu brjod pa'o/ /bzhi pa 'khyams na mon sran rnge'u sogs kyi dzambu ti ka'i zhal zas dang / mgon po'i bris sku gri gug sogs dam rdzas rnams brdabs shing mgon po'i yi ge bcu gnyis ma drag tu bzlas so/ /lnga pa las ma btub na dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa dbus su bzlum por bskor la padma 'dab ma bzhi pa/ de'i phyi skor la sgo stod la tshon gyis bri'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su mgon po bskyed la/ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ mchod bstod phul la 'di skad bskul lo/ /hūm̐ las kyi rigs mchog dpal ldan gos sngon can/ /mgon po 'dul phyir sku mdog 'jigs tshul ston/ /drag po'i rdo rjes mgon po 'dul mdzad pa/ /las kyi rigs mchog thugs dam dus la babs/ /oṃ nī lā ba ra dha ra sa ra tra ma tā ra swāhā/ tadya thā/ oṃ hi li hi la/ stag gi ni staṃ bha ni swāhā/ pho lha dang dbye ba'i sngags 'di/ dgra'i ming gi mtha' bskor/

de nas/ 'das dang ma byon da ltar gyis/ /zhes pa la sogs pas bskul lo/ /drug pa sbod kha 'doms na/ khyi thod du pho lha dang dbral te dgra'i liṅga la ming rus bris la dgug gzhug bya/ gu gul nag po'i dud pas pho lha la bdug cing sngags 'di bzlas/ ma shan ting sha ra ti ku ru pa na/ ma hā kā lā mi taṃ pho lha phye/ /glo bo glo 'dab rnag gis khong / /rus pa'i khab kyi glo snying rtsa bar phug /khyi thod du'ang lha dang dbral ba'i sngags la dgra'i ming dang sngags spel gyin bzhug sngags ni shaṃ yaṃ naṃ de bo ka la pa trā/ ma hā kā lā ya/ sa tra glib pa ni dra cha la ban li ni/ sngags 'di liṅga'i mtha' la bskor/ mi dang spun zlar phye/ de yang gu gul gyi dud pas bdug ra'i thod pa'i nang du shog bu'i gzhogs gcig la ming rus bri/ gzhogs gcig la gri gug bri/ liṅga'i mtha' ma bsnyen sngags kyi bskor zhing / oṃ ma hā kā la hri da ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'i yi ge bcu pa bzlas/ 'dab ma bzhi la sngags dang dbus su mgon po'i tsaka li bris pa dang / de'i mthar ming spel bsrung gcig pa phyi'i mu khyud la sngags ring la sogs man ngag bzhin bris la/ spyang thod du'ang yul lha dang pho lha'i sngags dral ba 'di gzhug ste/ pho lha dang yul lha sbrel ba'i sngags gang zhes na/ oṃ bandha bandha ba su/ ru dhe/ i ka ud pa sa sud tra mu khi ra tsa traṃ/ tsitta la rbud/ mahā kā lā raksha la'u sa/ na mā ra ya rbad/ thod pa dar gyi gril la sngags bzlas/ bsrung ba gdags/ nyams mkhan la dri/ lha 'dre byung na bden pa brdar la phud gtor/ des ma thub na sngags 'di bzlas/ oṃ sarba duṣṭan/ badzra sarba/ gal gi na/ dn-ir phaṭa phaṭa/ hya hyan badzra pā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa/ a mu ke rbud tu ta ri thum ril gnod byed 'di la mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa bzlas/ de nas lam rgya gram du song ste der dong gru gsum brus la dbus su rdo rje gcig bris/ der thod pa byin rim pa bzhin du gzhug

de nas las sbyor gyi sngags zlos shing mnan no/ /gtor ma la brten te dgra bsad pa'i zhal shes ni/ gtor ma cog zlum 'theb kyus bskor ba bzos nas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dbus kyi snying po/ de'i steng du yi dam/ de'i 'og tu mgon po/ de'i 'og tu lha mo/ de'i 'og tu gnod sbyin yab yum/ de'i 'og tu pu tra ming sring rnams bskyed/ 'theb kyu rnams dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag tu bsam nas bdud rtsir byin gyis rlabs te mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa la dbul/ de yang mtheb kyu'i steng du dong gru gsum bzos nas liṅga sngags can yin na shog bu la bris gan rkyal lam kha phub tu 'jug sngags men yin na zan la bcos yan lag mgo bo rnams bkyigs nas 'jug gsungs/ liṅga la dgug gzhug lha dbye sogs gong du bstan pa bzhin byas la dong gru gsum pa'i kha zan gyis bcad/ dmigs pa gtor ma'i snying po'i rtse mor nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hūm̐ mthing nag gcig bsam/ de las las mkhan rnams 'phros nas liṅga dgra bor dngos su bsam pa de tha re tho rer btubs nas mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa la'ang dbul/ kho rang rnams kyi'ang sha la zos/ khrag la 'thung bar mos pa byed pa yin no/ /de ltar rim pa 'di rnams gzhan la ston pa dang / rang gi nyams su len pa thams cad la rtog bzo'i dri ma spangs te bla ma yi dam dpangs su btsugs nas zog gi rnam pa tsam yang ma shor ba'i thugs rtog shin tu zhib par mdzad dgos so/ /phyi'i sgrub pa dkyil 'khor la brten pa/ nang gi sgrub pa dkyil 'khor de'i dbus su thod pa snying snas bkang pa bzhag ste sgrub pa yin kyang bla ma las man ngag zur du thob dgos so/ /de rnams kyi bla ma yi dam lha brgyad mkha' 'gro sbags sgrub lus dkyil rdzogs rim dang bcas pa'i man ngag dang bcas pa'i man ngag dam pa/ snying nang gi khrag lta bu'i gdams pa zab mo rnams nub dogs shin tu zhib par khyed rnams la phul ba yin pas/

bstan pa dang sems can snying khong bcangs pa'i nyams su len pa dang / gzhan la ston pa sogs 'gro phan rgya che bar mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yi sogs brjod la slob ma rnams rang gnas su gtang ngo / /'di lta bu'i khrid kyi rim pa gsal bar bkod pa 'di ni snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa mahā paṇḍi ta chen po sa lo 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / bka' drin mchog tu che ba'i sbas pa'i rnal 'byor mkhas grub dpal ldan bkra shis pa/ yongs 'dzin dam pa 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog lhun grub rnams kyi rjes su bzung zhing bka' drin gyi brtse ba chen pos bskyangs te bka' srol khyad par can/ mal gyo lo tsā ba nas rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po kun dga' snying po las brgyud pa bar ma chad pa'i gur gyi mgon po'i rdzogs rim lus dkyil bsgom tshul gyi khrid kyi rim pa gsal bar bstan pa 'di ni rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam gsum gyi gsung rgyun dri ma med pa cung zad zin pa rnams kyis legs par brgyan nas bla ma rnam gsum gyis zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa chos med snyoms las mkhan za nyal 'chag gi rnal 'byor pa rgan pa sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis rigs kyi bu spun dang 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog lhun grub kyi gdung dbon dkon mchog dpal ldan gyi kyang bskul ba'i ngor dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po bzhi thog bla brang du bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsrung ma rnams la gsol ba btab nas sug bris bgyis pa 'di la nyes pa ci mchis pa thams cad bla ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ 'dis kyang bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung ba'i 'phrin las dam pa mdzad du gsol/ oṃ e ka dza ṭi de wa ind+ra si hūm̐ bhyoḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badzra kā la yakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kā li yakṣi ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa/
